Key takeaways

- Advocate raised $18 million in seed funding from Vestigo Ventures, Brewer Lane, MetaProp, and select family offices, and came out of stealth on August 4, 2026 after five years of operating privately.
- The platform is built on $7.3 billion in real premium across 70,000 policies, and tracks insurance compliance across more than $1.3 trillion in commercial real estate assets.
- Market Terminal benchmarks a policy against comparable risk in minutes, replacing manual reviews that take days.
- Coverage ran across venture, fintech, and insurance trade press, led by an Axios exclusive from Ryan Lawler and same-day coverage in Reuters' The Insurer.
- Dealroom placed the round in roughly the 99th percentile of all US seed rounds on record.

**New York, NY, August 4, 2026:** Advocate Technologies announced its public launch after operating in stealth since 2020, alongside **$18 million in seed funding** from Vestigo Ventures, Brewer Lane, MetaProp, and select family offices.

### Every major market has a price except this one

Every stock, bond, and derivative traded in global markets has a discoverable price. Commercial insurance does not.

A single commercial policy can run past 200 pages, with limits, exclusions, endorsements, and carrier ratings that make a surface level premium comparison misleading. Two buildings on the same block, insured to the same liability limit, can be priced against entirely different assumptions about risk. Buyers, lenders, and asset managers have had one reference point available to them: a quote delivered through an intermediary, in a market where comparable pricing stays hidden.

That opacity has a cost, and it shows up in the premium. When nobody can see the spread, **the spread widens**.

### What Advocate built

Advocate spent five years building the data network that closes the gap, starting with insurance operations work for loan servicers and brokers and accumulating cleared, transaction level placement data along the way.

Market Terminal reads each policy, resolves it into standardized data through our proprietary World Insurance Model, and benchmarks it against comparable risk **in minutes rather than days**. Brokers, lenders, risk managers, and property owners use it to find coverage gaps, look up carrier pricing, build data-driven proposals, understand carrier appetite, and manage compliance across entire portfolios.

The platform tracks insurance compliance across more than $1.3 trillion in commercial real estate assets.

> You can find the market price and financial details of any stock, bond, derivative, or other products traded in global markets, except for insurance. Every major market has gone through a transparency event that enables practitioners to better serve customers. When it happens, the market expands.

Ashwin Agarwal, CEO and co-founder, Advocate Technologies

The funding will go toward scaling the data network, expanding self-service access for brokers, lenders, risk managers and property owners, and continuing weekly market intelligence through the Advocate Insurance Desk.

Is your premium above market?The benchmarks this round is funding are free to try. Enter a premium and see where it lands against real comparable placements from the data network. [Benchmark your premium](https://www.advocate.app/#premium-benchmark)

### What's next

The data network compounds. Every broker, lender, risk manager, and owner who benchmarks a policy in Market Terminal **expands the underlying dataset**, which sharpens pricing and coverage insight for everyone using it.

We publish what we find. The Advocate Insurance Desk covers commercial insurance pricing and coverage trends weekly, anchored to our own cleared placement data. Subscribe to the newsletter or follow the podcast to see the market read as it develops.
